overview.description: The RJ ClariVest Capital Appreciation ETF (RJCA) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF that aims for long-term capital appreciation by investing in growth companies of any market capitalization. RJCA was launched on Aug 3, 2026 and is issued by Raymond James.
